rules: No heavy animations, use subtle micro-interactions like light shadows on hover.
Proper spacing and alignment, prioritize optical alignment over pure geometric.
Prioritize high contrast and legibility, suitable for B2B industrial clients.
Use solid containers with slight border-radius (`rounded-sm` or `rounded-md`) for an engineered feel.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A66C2] text-white hover:bg-[#084e96] rounded-sm transition-colors duration-200 px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.outline: border border-[#0A66C2] text-[#0A66C2] hover:bg-blue-50 rounded-sm transition-colors duration-200 px-6 py-3 font-medium

cards.service_card: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md p-6 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300
cards.infrastructure_card: bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center rounded-sm

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200

hero.content_alignment: left-aligned or centered based on layout preference, strong contrast.

Instagram feed placeholder (Grid of 4-6 square blocks).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the blue (#0A66C2) and white theme.
Implement the Embla carousel for the Hero Section.
Ensure the navbar is sticky and responsive.
Use light shadows and slight translations on hover, avoiding complex/heavy animations.
Install and use lucide-react for icons.
Use Chivo font for headings and Manrope for body text. Add these via Google Fonts in index.html.
Build standard React components for Marketing pages using standard HTML/Tailwind, reserving Shadcn UI for forms or interactive bits if needed.
